episode_title: Why Financial Advisors Lose Prospects Before the First Meeting

real_qa.q: What do financial prospects research before scheduling a first meeting with an advisor?
real_qa.r: By the time a prospect raises their hand, they have already Googled the advisor, visited the website, checked LinkedIn, watched videos, read reviews, and compared the advisor to other options. They are conducting extensive research to determine credibility, relevance, and whether they want to work with this person before any formal contact occurs.
real_qa.requete: what prospects research before meeting financial advisor

real_qa.q: Why do Google search results function as a second homepage for financial advisors?
real_qa.r: Google results serve as a second homepage because prospects rely on what Google serves up to make a gut reaction about whether the advisor is worthy. The search results effectively communicate to the prospect whether Google thinks this person is legitimate and worth considering, influencing their decision to pursue a relationship.
real_qa.requete: Google search results financial advisor credibility second homepage

real_qa.q: What must financial advisors communicate on their website within 10 to 20 seconds?
real_qa.r: Within 10 to 20 seconds, prospects need to quickly determine: who you work with, what you do to help them, whether you are relevant to someone like them, and what happens if they contact you. The website must clearly articulate the client process and experience, demonstrating that you have a structured methodology to guide them.
real_qa.requete: financial advisor website first 10 20 seconds prospects determine

real_qa.q: How can financial advisors use retargeting ads to address prospect procrastination?
real_qa.r: Retargeting ads can be deployed with a small budget to continuously serve videos, content, and educational materials to prospects who visited the website but did not take action. These subtle reminders keep the advisor top-of-mind and provide the nudge needed to move prospects from procrastination to taking action when timing aligns with their needs.
real_qa.requete: retargeting ads financial advisors prospect procrastination

real_qa.q: What specific actions should financial advisors take immediately after a prospect schedules a meeting?
real_qa.r: After a prospect schedules a meeting, advisors should send a confirmation email thanking them, provide an agenda, include a map to the office or clarity on digital meeting details, and consider sending an introduction kit or video about the advisor and firm. This ensures the prospect remains engaged and receives a warm, professional experience leading up to the first appointment.
